text:
对当前 app/home_panel/home_panel_main.c 做一次纯结构重构，不进行任何 UI 视觉改版，不修改业务行为，不修改网络、米家和主动智能算法。

目标是把 LVGL UI 层从主文件拆分出来，使后续可以独立按照 Xiaomi Home UI Skill 重做界面。

要求：

新建 app/home_panel/ui/。
将颜色、圆角、字号、间距等统一视觉定义移动到 home_ui_theme.c/.h。
将设备卡、场景卡、导航项、指标卡等通用组件移动到 home_ui_components.c/.h。
将家庭、房间、设备详情、场景、主动智能、设置六个页面分别拆分为独立源文件。
页面只能通过明确的 UI API 接收 model/state，不允许直接依赖网络线程、MIoT 请求实现或主动智能内部状态。
原有功能、布局、坐标、颜色、文字、交互必须保持不变，本次不得“顺便优化 UI”。
每拆一个模块立即编译，避免一次性大迁移。
禁止大规模重写业务代码，优先使用移动、封装和最小接口抽取。
最终 home_panel_main.c 只保留初始化、状态协调和主循环。
输出重构前后依赖关系和每个新文件的职责。

开始前先完整阅读当前 home_panel_main.c、相关头文件、CMake/Makefile/Kconfig，并制定拆分顺序；确认计划后再开始修改。 本次不得顺便优化 UI。在openvela文件夹内。有什么不懂的去读Codex的记忆和历史消息

448: static void update_time_ui(bool force)
449: {
450:   static const char *weekdays[] =
451:   {
452:     "星期日", "星期一", "星期二", "星期三",
453:     "星期四", "星期五", "星期六"
454:   };
455:   struct tm local_time;
456:   char clock_text[16];
457:   char date_text[48];
458:   uint32_t now_ms = lv_tick_get();
459:   time_t now;
460:   int ret;
461: 
462:   if (!force && lv_tick_elaps(g_last_time_update) <
463:       TIME_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS)
464:     {
465:       return;
466:     }
467: 
468:   g_last_time_update = now_ms;
469:   if (g_network_state == NETWORK_ONLINE && !g_ntp_started &&
470:       (g_next_ntp_attempt == 0 ||
471:        (int32_t)(now_ms - g_next_ntp_attempt) >= 0))
472:     {
473:       ret = ntpc_start();
474:       if (ret >= 0 || ret == -EALREADY)
475:         {
476:           g_ntp_started = true;
477:           syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][TIME] ntp client started pid=%d\n",
478:                  ret);
479:         }
480:       else
481:         {
482:           g_next_ntp_attempt = now_ms + NTP_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS;
483:           syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][TIME] ntp start failed ret=%d\n",
484:                  ret);
485:         }
486:     }
487: 
488:   now = time(NULL);
489:   if (now < TIME_VALID_EPOCH)
490:     {
491:       if (g_clock_label != NULL)
492:         {
493:           set_label_text_if_changed(g_clock_label, "--:--");
494:         }
495:       if (g_date_label != NULL)
496:         {
497:           set_label_text_if_changed(g_date_label, "等待网络校时");
498:         }
499:       return;
500:     }
501: 
502:   if (!g_time_synced)
503:     {
504:       g_time_synced = true;
505:       syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][TIME] synchronized epoch=%ld timezone=UTC+8\n",
506:              (long)now);
507:     }
508: 
509:   now += 8 * 60 * 60;
510:   gmtime_r(&now, &local_time);
511:   snprintf(clock_text, sizeof(clock_text), "%02d:%02d",
512:            local_time.tm_hour, local_time.tm_min);
513:   snprintf(date_text, sizeof(date_text), "%d月%d日  %s",
514:            local_time.tm_mon + 1, local_time.tm_mday,
515:            weekdays[local_time.tm_wday]);
516:   if (g_clock_label != NULL)
517:     {
518:       set_label_text_if_changed(g_clock_label, clock_text);
519:     }
520:   if (g_date_label != NULL)
521:     {
522:       set_label_text_if_changed(g_date_label, date_text);
523:     }
524: }

601: static uint16_t network_ping_checksum(const void *buffer, size_t length)
602: {
603:   const uint16_t *word = buffer;
604:   uint32_t sum = 0;
605: 
606:   while (length > 1)
607:     {
608:       sum += *word++;
609:       length -= 2;
610:     }
611: 
612:   if (length != 0)
613:     {
614:       sum += *(const uint8_t *)word;
615:     }
616: 
617:   while ((sum >> 16) != 0)
618:     {
619:       sum = (sum & 0xffff) + (sum >> 16);
620:     }
621: 
622:   return (uint16_t)~sum;
623: }

691: static bool network_dns_skip_name(const uint8_t *message, size_t length,
692:                                   size_t *offset)
693: {
694:   while (*offset < length)
695:     {
696:       uint8_t label_length = message[(*offset)++];
697: 
698:       if (label_length == 0)
699:         {
700:           return true;
701:         }
702: 
703:       if ((label_length & 0xc0) == 0xc0)
704:         {
705:           if (*offset >= length)
706:             {
707:               return false;
708:             }
709: 
710:           (*offset)++;
711:           return true;
712:         }
713: 
714:       if (label_length > 63 || *offset + label_length > length)
715:         {
716:           return false;
717:         }
718: 
719:       *offset += label_length;
720:     }
721: 
722:   return false;
723: }

725: static bool network_resolve_host(const char *hostname,
726:                                  struct in_addr *resolved_address)
727: {
728:   struct sockaddr_in dns_server;
729:   uint8_t query[NETWORK_DNS_BUFFER_SIZE];
730:   uint8_t response[NETWORK_DNS_BUFFER_SIZE];
731:   struct dns_header_s *header = (struct dns_header_s *)query;
732:   const char *label = hostname;
733:   uint16_t query_id = ++g_network_dns_id;
734:   size_t query_length = sizeof(struct dns_header_s);
735:   unsigned int poll_count;
736:   int sockfd;
737:   int ret;
738: 
739:   if (!network_get_dns_server(&dns_server))
740:     {
741:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-server=missing\n",
742:              hostname);
743:       return false;
744:     }
745: 
746:   memset(query, 0, sizeof(query));
747:   header->id = htons(query_id);
748:   header->flags1 = DNS_FLAG1_RD;
749:   header->numquestions = htons(1);
750: 
751:   while (*label != '\0')
752:     {
753:       const char *dot = strchr(label, '.');
754:       size_t label_length = dot == NULL ? strlen(label) :
755:                                           (size_t)(dot - label);
756: 
757:       if (label_length == 0 || label_length > 63 ||
758:           query_length + label_length + 6 > sizeof(query))
759:         {
760:           return false;
761:         }
762: 
763:       query[query_length++] = (uint8_t)label_length;
764:       memcpy(&query[query_length], label, label_length);
765:       query_length += label_length;
766:       if (dot == NULL)
767:         {
768:           break;
769:         }
770: 
771:       label = dot + 1;
772:     }
773: 
774:   query[query_length++] = 0;
775:   network_dns_write_u16(&query[query_length], DNS_RECTYPE_A);
776:   query_length += 2;
777:   network_dns_write_u16(&query[query_length], DNS_CLASS_IN);
778:   query_length += 2;
779: 
780:   sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
781:   if (sockfd < 0)
782:     {
783:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-socket=%d\n",
784:              hostname, errno);
785:       return false;
786:     }
787: 
788:   if (fcntl(sockfd, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0)
789:     {
790:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-nonblock=%d\n",
791:              hostname, errno);
792:       close(sockfd);
793:       return false;
794:     }
795: 
796:   ret = sendto(sockfd, query, query_length, MSG_DONTWAIT,
797:                (const struct sockaddr *)&dns_server,
798:                sizeof(dns_server));
799:   if (ret != (int)query_length)
800:     {
801:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-send=%d errno=%d\n",
802:              hostname, ret, errno);
803:       close(sockfd);
804:       return false;
805:     }
806: 
807:   for (poll_count = 0; poll_count < NETWORK_PING_POLLS; poll_count++)
808:     {
809:       ssize_t received;
810: 
811:       received = recvfrom(sockfd, response, sizeof(response),
812:                           MSG_DONTWAIT, NULL, NULL);
813:       if (received >= (ssize_t)sizeof(struct dns_header_s))
814:         {
815:           struct dns_header_s *response_header =
816:             (struct dns_header_s *)response;
817:           size_t offset = sizeof(struct dns_header_s);
818:           unsigned int index;
819: 
820:           if (ntohs(response_header->id) != query_id ||
821:               (response_header->flags1 & DNS_FLAG1_RESPONSE) == 0 ||
822:               (response_header->flags2 & DNS_FLAG2_ERR_MASK) != 0)
823:             {
824:               continue;
825:             }
826: 
827:           for (index = 0;
828:                index < ntohs(response_header->numquestions); index++)
829:             {
830:               if (!network_dns_skip_name(response, received, &offset) ||
831:                   offset + 4 > (size_t)received)
832:                 {
833:                   break;
834:                 }
835: 
836:               offset += 4;
837:             }
838: 
839:           for (index = 0; index < ntohs(response_header->numanswers);
840:                index++)
841:             {
842:               uint16_t record_type;
843:               uint16_t record_class;
844:               uint16_t record_length;
845: 
846:               if (!network_dns_skip_name(response, received, &offset) ||
847:                   offset + 10 > (size_t)received)
848:                 {
849:                   break;
850:                 }
851: 
852:               record_type = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset]);
853:               record_class = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset + 2]);
854:               record_length = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset + 8]);
855:               offset += 10;
856:               if (offset + record_length > (size_t)received)
857:                 {
858:                   break;
859:                 }
860: 
861:               if (record_type == DNS_RECTYPE_A &&
862:                   record_class == DNS_CLASS_IN && record_length == 4)
863:                 {
864:                   memcpy(resolved_address, &response[offset], 4);
865:                   close(sockfd);
866:                   return true;
867:                 }
868: 
869:               offset += record_length;
870:             }
871:         }
872:       else if (received < 0 && errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK &&
873:                errno != EINTR)
874:         {
875:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
876:                  "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-recv=%d\n", hostname, errno);
877:           break;
878:         }
879: 
880:       usleep(NETWORK_PING_POLL_US);
881:     }
882: 
883:   syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-timeout\n", hostname);
884:   close(sockfd);
885:   return false;
886: }

888: static int network_ping_host(const char *hostname)
889: {
890:   struct network_ping_packet_s packet;
891:   struct sockaddr_in destination;
892:   uint8_t receive_buffer[64];
893:   uint16_t ping_id;
894:   unsigned int poll_count;
895:   int sockfd;
896:   int ret;
897: 
898:   memset(&destination, 0, sizeof(destination));
899:   destination.sin_family = AF_INET;
900:   if (!network_resolve_host(hostname, &destination.sin_addr))
901:     {
902:       return 0;
903:     }
904: 
905:   sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_ICMP);
906:   if (sockfd < 0)
907:     {
908:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s socket=%d\n",
909:              hostname, errno);
910:       return 0;
911:     }
912: 
913:   if (fcntl(sockfd, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0)
914:     {
915:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s nonblock=%d\n",
916:              hostname, errno);
917:       close(sockfd);
918:       return 0;
919:     }
920: 
921:   memset(&packet, 0, sizeof(packet));
922:   ping_id = ++g_network_ping_id;
923:   packet.header.type = ICMP_ECHO_REQUEST;
924:   packet.header.id = htons(ping_id);
925:   packet.header.seqno = htons(1);
926:   memset(packet.data, 0x5a, sizeof(packet.data));
927:   packet.header.icmpchksum = network_ping_checksum(&packet,
928:                                                    sizeof(packet));
929: 
930:   ret = sendto(sockfd, &packet, sizeof(packet), MSG_DONTWAIT,
931:                (const struct sockaddr *)&destination,
932:                sizeof(destination));
933:   if (ret != (int)sizeof(packet))
934:     {
935:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s send=%d errno=%d\n",
936:              hostname, ret, errno);
937:       close(sockfd);
938:       return 0;
939:     }
940: 
941:   for (poll_count = 0; poll_count < NETWORK_PING_POLLS; poll_count++)
942:     {
943:       ssize_t received;
944:       size_t offset = 0;
945:       struct icmp_hdr_s *reply;
946: 
947:       received = recvfrom(sockfd, receive_buffer, sizeof(receive_buffer),
948:                           MSG_DONTWAIT, NULL, NULL);
949:       if (received > 0)
950:         {
951:           if ((receive_buffer[0] >> 4) == 4)
952:             {
953:               offset = (receive_buffer[0] & 0x0f) * 4;
954:             }
955: 
956:           if ((size_t)received >= offset + sizeof(struct icmp_hdr_s))
957:             {
958:               reply = (struct icmp_hdr_s *)(receive_buffer + offset);
959:               if (reply->type == ICMP_ECHO_REPLY &&
960:                   ntohs(reply->id) == ping_id &&
961:                   ntohs(reply->seqno) == 1)
962:                 {
963:                   close(sockfd);
964:                   return 1;
965:                 }
966:             }
967:         }
968:       else if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK && errno != EINTR)
969:         {
970:           syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s recv=%d\n",
971:                  hostname, errno);
972:           break;
973:         }
974: 
975:       usleep(NETWORK_PING_POLL_US);
976:     }
977: 
978:   close(sockfd);
979:   return 0;
980: }

982: static void *network_worker(void *arg)
983: {
984:   unsigned int elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
985:   unsigned int initial_down_seconds = 0;
986:   bool was_connected = false;
987:   bool link_seen = false;
988:   enum network_link_state_e last_link = NETWORK_LINK_INITIALIZING;
989:   uint8_t last_flags = UINT8_MAX;
990: 
991:   (void)arg;
992: 
993:   for (;;)
994:     {
995:       uint8_t flags;
996:       enum network_link_state_e link = network_get_link_state(&flags);
997:       bool connected = link == NETWORK_LINK_UP;
998:       bool refresh = g_network_refresh_requested;
999:       struct in_addr address;
1000: 
1001:       if (link != last_link || flags != last_flags)
1002:         {
1003:           const char *link_name = link == NETWORK_LINK_UP ? "up" :
1004:                                   link == NETWORK_LINK_DOWN ? "down" :
1005:                                   "initializing";
1006: 
1007:           syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][NET] carrier=%s flags=%02x\n",
1008:                  link_name, flags);
1009:           last_link = link;
1010:           last_flags = flags;
1011:         }
1012: 
1013:       g_network_refresh_requested = false;
1014:       if (link == NETWORK_LINK_INITIALIZING)
1015:         {
1016:           network_set_state(NETWORK_INITIALIZING);
1017:           was_connected = false;
1018:           elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
1019:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
1020:         }
1021:       else if (!connected)
1022:         {
1023:           if (!link_seen && initial_down_seconds < NETWORK_LINK_GRACE_SEC)
1024:             {
1025:               network_set_state(NETWORK_INITIALIZING);
1026:               initial_down_seconds++;
1027:             }
1028:           else
1029:             {
1030:               network_set_state(NETWORK_DISCONNECTED);
1031:             }
1032:           was_connected = false;
1033:           elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
1034:         }
1035:       else if (!network_get_ipv4_address(&address))
1036:         {
1037:           /* DHCP runs independently. Keep checking without reporting a
1038:            * false Internet failure while an address is being acquired.
1039:            */
1040: 
1041:           network_set_state(NETWORK_CHECKING);
1042:           link_seen = true;
1043:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
1044:           was_connected = false;
1045:         }
1046:       else if (!was_connected || refresh ||
1047:                elapsed >= NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL)
1048:         {
1049:           int replies;
1050:           char address_text[INET_ADDRSTRLEN];
1051: 
1052:           /* Keep the last definitive result visible during an automatic
1053:            * background probe.  Only initial and user-requested probes show
1054:            * the transient checking state.
1055:            */
1056: 
1057:           if (!was_connected || refresh)
1058:             {
1059:               network_set_state(NETWORK_CHECKING);
1060:             }
1061:           link_seen = true;
1062:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
1063:           inet_ntop(AF_INET, &address, address_text, sizeof(address_text));
1064:           replies = network_ping_host("mi.com");
1065:           if (replies <= 0 && network_has_carrier())
1066:             {
1067:               replies = network_ping_host("xiaomi.cn");
1068:             }
1069: 
1070:           if (!network_has_carrier())
1071:             {
1072:               network_set_state(NETWORK_DISCONNECTED);
1073:             }
1074:           else
1075:             {
1076:               network_set_state(replies > 0 ? NETWORK_ONLINE :
1077:                                               NETWORK_NO_INTERNET);
1078:               syslog(LOG_INFO,
1079:                      "[HOME][NET] health ipv4=%s result=%s\n",
1080:                      address_text, replies > 0 ? "online" : "unreachable");
1081:             }
1082: 
1083:           was_connected = true;
1084:           elapsed = 0;
1085:         }
1086:       else
1087:         {
1088:           elapsed++;
1089:         }
1090: 
1091:       sleep(1);
1092:     }
1093: 
1094:   return NULL;
1095: }

1097: static int start_network_monitor(void)
1098: {
1099:   pthread_attr_t attr;
1100:   struct sched_param param;
1101:   pthread_t thread;
1102:   int ret;
1103: 
1104:   ret = pthread_attr_init(&attr);
1105:   if (ret != 0)
1106:     {
1107:       return ret;
1108:     }
1109: 
1110:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, NETWORK_THREAD_STACK);
1111:   pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
1112:   memset(&param, 0, sizeof(param));
1113:   param.sched_priority = NETWORK_THREAD_PRIORITY;
1114:   pthread_attr_setschedparam(&attr, &param);
1115:   pthread_attr_setinheritsched(&attr, PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED);
1116:   ret = pthread_create(&thread, &attr, network_worker, NULL);
1117:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
1118:   return ret;
1119: }

376: void theme_apply_card_state(lv_obj_t *obj,
377:                             enum home_panel_card_state_e state)
378: {
379:   lv_color_t start = lv_color_hex(COLOR_SURFACE_2);
380:   lv_color_t end = lv_color_hex(COLOR_SURFACE);
381:   lv_color_t border = lv_color_hex(COLOR_BORDER);
382:   lv_opa_t opacity = LV_OPA_COVER;
383: 
384:   switch (state)
385:     {
386:       case HOME_PANEL_CARD_ACTIVE:
387:         start = lv_color_hex(0x25423a);
388:         end = lv_color_hex(0x1b2b28);
389:         border = lv_color_hex(0x2f6759);
390:         break;
391:       case HOME_PANEL_CARD_OFFLINE:
392:         opacity = LV_OPA_60;
393:         break;
394:       case HOME_PANEL_CARD_LOADING:
395:         border = lv_color_hex(COLOR_SENSOR);
396:         opacity = LV_OPA_80;
397:         break;
398:       case HOME_PANEL_CARD_ERROR:
399:         border = lv_color_hex(COLOR_RED);
400:         break;
401:       case HOME_PANEL_CARD_IDLE:
402:       default:
403:         break;
404:     }
405: 
406:   lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(obj, start, 0);
407:   lv_obj_set_style_bg_grad_color(obj, end, 0);
408:   lv_obj_set_style_bg_grad_dir(obj, LV_GRAD_DIR_VER, 0);
409:   lv_obj_set_style_border_color(obj, border, 0);
410:   lv_obj_set_style_opa(obj, opacity, 0);
411: }

21: static void fast_button_configure(lv_obj_t *button)

27:   if (!initialized)

33:   lv_obj_set_style_transition(button, &trans, 0);
34:   lv_obj_set_style_transition(button, &trans, LV_STATE_PRESSED);
35:   lv_obj_set_style_anim_duration(button, 0, 0);
36:   lv_obj_set_style_shadow_width(button, 0, 0);
37:   lv_obj_set_style_transform_width(button, 0, LV_STATE_PRESSED);

42: {
43:   const char *current;

50:   current = lv_label_get_text(label);

57:   return false;

2016: static void format_device_value(const struct home_panel_device_s *device,
2017:                                 char *value, size_t capacity)
2018: {
2019:   const struct home_panel_control_s *volume;
2020: 
2021:   if (device->has_brightness)
2022:     {
2023:       int span = device->brightness_max - device->brightness_min;
2024:       int percent = span > 0 ?
2025:         (device->brightness - device->brightness_min) * 100 / span : 0;
2026: 
2027:       snprintf(value, capacity, "%d%%", percent);
2028:     }
2029:   else if (device->has_temperature)
2030:     {
2031:       snprintf(value, capacity, "%d°C", device->temperature);
2032:     }
2033:   else if (device->has_humidity)
2034:     {
2035:       snprintf(value, capacity, "湿度 %d%%", device->humidity);
2036:     }
2037:   else if (device->has_battery)
2038:     {
2039:       snprintf(value, capacity, "%d%%", device->battery);
2040:     }
2041:   else
2042:     {
2043:       volume = find_device_control(device, "volume");
2044:       if (volume != NULL && volume->has_value)
2045:         {
2046:           snprintf(value, capacity, "音量 %d%%", volume->value);
2047:         }
2048:       else
2049:         {
2050:           snprintf(value, capacity, "%s",
2051:                    device->online ? "在线" : "离线");
2052:         }
2053:     }
2054: }

2284: static unsigned int select_device_cards(unsigned int selected[3])
2285: {
2286:   bool used[HOME_PANEL_MAX_DEVICES] = {false};
2287:   unsigned int count = 0;
2288: 
2289:   while (count < 3)
2290:     {
2291:       int best_score = -1;
2292:       unsigned int best = 0;
2293:       unsigned int index;
2294: 
2295:       for (index = 0; index < g_family_model.device_count; index++)
2296:         {
2297:           int score;
2298: 
2299:           if (used[index])
2300:             {
2301:               continue;
2302:             }
2303:           score = device_card_score(&g_family_model.devices[index]);
2304:           if (score > best_score)
2305:             {
2306:               best_score = score;
2307:               best = index;
2308:             }
2309:         }
2310: 
2311:       if (best_score < 0)
2312:         {

3486:   syslog(ret == 0 ? LOG_INFO : LOG_WARNING,
3487:          "[HOME][AGENT] profile persist ret=%d bytes=%u\n",
3488:          ret, (unsigned int)work->length);
3489:   free(work);
3490:   flags = up_irq_save();
3491:   g_proactive_persist_busy = false;
3492:   up_irq_restore(flags);
3493:   return NULL;
3494: }

3496: static void schedule_proactive_persist(void)
3497: {
3498:   struct proactive_persist_work_s *work;
3499:   struct sched_param param;
3500:   irqstate_t flags;
3501:   pthread_attr_t attr;
3502:   pthread_t thread;
3503:   int ret;
3504: 
3505:   flags = up_irq_save();
3506:   if (g_proactive_persist_busy)
3507:     {
3508:       g_proactive_persist_pending = true;
3509:       up_irq_restore(flags);
3510:       return;
3511:     }
3512:   g_proactive_persist_busy = true;
3513:   g_proactive_persist_pending = false;
3514:   up_irq_restore(flags);
3515: 
3516:   work = calloc(1, sizeof(*work));
3517:   if (work == NULL)
3518:     {
3519:       ret = -ENOMEM;
3520:       goto fail;
3521:     }
3522: 
3523:   ret = build_agent_persist_record(work->data, sizeof(work->data),
3524:                                    &work->length);
3525:   if (ret < 0)
3526:     {
3527:       free(work);
3528:       work = NULL;
3529:       goto fail;
3530:     }
3531: 
3532:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
3533:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, PROACTIVE_THREAD_STACK);
3534:   pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
3535:   pthread_attr_setinheritsched(&attr, PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED);
3536:   pthread_attr_setschedpolicy(&attr, SCHED_RR);
3537:   memset(&param, 0, sizeof(param));
3538:   param.sched_priority = 45;
3539:   pthread_attr_setschedparam(&attr, &param);
3540:   ret = pthread_create(&thread, &attr, proactive_persist_worker, work);
3541:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
3542:   if (ret != 0)
3543:     {
3544:       free(work);
3545:       goto fail;
3546:     }
3547:   return;
3548: 
3549: fail:
3550:   flags = up_irq_save();
3551:   g_proactive_persist_busy = false;
3552:   g_proactive_persist_pending = true;
3553:   g_proactive_persist_retry_at =
3554:     lv_tick_get() + PROACTIVE_PERSIST_RETRY_MS;
3555:   up_irq_restore(flags);
3556:   syslog(LOG_WARNING,
3557:          "[HOME][AGENT] profile worker start failed ret=%d\n", ret);
3558: }
3559: 
3560: static bool proactive_persist_retry_ready(void)
3561: {
3562:   irqstate_t flags;
3563:   bool ready;
3564: 
3565:   flags = up_irq_save();
3566:   ready = g_proactive_persist_pending && !g_proactive_persist_busy &&
3567:           (int32_t)(lv_tick_get() - g_proactive_persist_retry_at) >= 0;
3568:   up_irq_restore(flags);
3569:   return ready;
3570: }

4061:   unsigned int index;

4064:     {
4065:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].routine_id) * 16777619u;
4066:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].trigger_device_hash) * 16777619u;
4067:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].action_device_hash) * 16777619u;
4068:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].action_siid) * 16777619u;
4069:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].action_piid) * 16777619u;

4796:               g_proactive_command.decision_key = before.decision_key;
4797:               g_proactive_command.deadline_ms = lv_tick_get() + 15000u;
4798:               g_proactive_command.siid = before.target_siid;
4799:               g_proactive_command.piid = before.target_piid;
4800:               g_proactive_command.value = 0;
4801:               g_proactive_command.kind = HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_BOOLEAN;
4802:               g_proactive_command.active = true;
4803:               g_proactive_command.feedback_pending = true;
4804:               g_proactive_command.feedback_on_success = feedback;
4805:             }
4806:         }
4807:       if (ret < 0)
4808:         {
4809:           set_label_text_if_changed(g_proactive_feedback_label,
4810:                                     ret == -EBUSY ?
4811:                                     "请等待上一条设备指令完成" :
4812:                                     "设备指令发送失败");
4813:           return;
4814:         }
4815:     }
4816: 
4817:   /* A device-changing acceptance is committed only after a matching MIoT
4818:    * state event confirms the requested value.  This prevents a transport
4819:    * failure from teaching the local profile that an action succeeded or
4820:    * installing an offline automation that was never verified.
4821:    */
4822: 
4823:   if (feedback != HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT &&
4824:       feedback != HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION)
4825:     {
4826:       home_proactive_feedback(feedback);
4827:     }
4828:   else if (ret == 1)
4829:     {
4830:       home_proactive_feedback(feedback);
4831:     }
4832:   if (before.mode == HOME_PROACTIVE_REAL &&
4833:       ((feedback != HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT &&
4834:         feedback != HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION) || ret == 1))
4835:     {
4836:       schedule_proactive_persist();
4837:     }
4838:   set_label_text_if_changed(
4839:     g_proactive_feedback_label,
4840:     feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION ?
4841:       (ret == 1 ? "设备已处于建议状态，已建立本地断网自动化" :
4842:                   "指令已发送，状态确认后才会建立离线自动化") :
4843:     feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT ?
4844:       (ret == 1 ? "设备已处于建议状态，已记录本次选择" :
4845:                   "指令已发送，等待设备状态确认") :
4846:     feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_IGNORE_TODAY ? "今天已忽略，已记录反馈" :
4847:                                              "已降低提醒频率");
4848:   update_proactive_widgets();

4859: static void process_proactive_automation(void)
4860: {
4861:   struct home_proactive_snapshot_s snapshot;
4862:   struct proactive_action_target_s target;
4863:   uint32_t now_ms = lv_tick_get();
4864:   int ret;
4865: 
4866:   if (g_proactive_command.active &&
4867:       (int32_t)(now_ms - g_proactive_command.deadline_ms) > 0)
4868:     {
4869:       if (g_proactive_command.cloud_execution)
4870:         {
4871:           cloud_finish_execution(false);
4872:         }
4873:       else if (g_proactive_command.automation)
4874:         {
4875:           home_proactive_automation_result(false);
4876:           schedule_proactive_persist();
4877:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
4878:                  "[HOME][AGENT] automation confirmation timeout key=%u\n",
4879:                  (unsigned int)g_proactive_command.decision_key);
4880:         }
4881:       memset(&g_proactive_command, 0, sizeof(g_proactive_command));
4882:     }
4883: 
4884:   home_proactive_get_snapshot(&snapshot);
4885:   if (!snapshot.automation_due ||
4886:       snapshot.candidate_kind == HOME_PROACTIVE_CANDIDATE_SLEEP ||
4887:       !proactive_resolve_action(&snapshot, &target))
4888:     {
4889:       return;
4890:     }
4891: 
4892:   if (!home_proactive_claim_automation(snapshot.decision_key))
4893:     {
4894:       return;
4895:     }
4896: 
4897:   ret = proactive_request_action(&snapshot, &target, true,
4898:                                  HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT, false);
4899:   if (ret == 1)
4900:     {
4901:       home_proactive_automation_result(true);
4902:       schedule_proactive_persist();
4903:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
4904:              "[HOME][AGENT] automation already satisfied key=%u\n",
4905:              (unsigned int)snapshot.decision_key);
4906:     }
4907:   else if (ret < 0)
4908:     {
4909:       home_proactive_automation_result(false);
4910:       schedule_proactive_persist();
4911:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
4912:              "[HOME][AGENT] automation send failed key=%u ret=%d\n",
4913:              (unsigned int)snapshot.decision_key, ret);
4914:     }
4915:   else
4916:     {
4917:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
4918:              "[HOME][AGENT] automation sent key=%u action=%u/%u\n",
4919:              (unsigned int)snapshot.decision_key,
4920:              snapshot.action_siid, snapshot.action_piid);
4921:     }
4922: }

5044: static void request_board_cloud_sync(
5045:   enum home_panel_mijia_state_e mijia_state)
5046: {
5047:   struct home_panel_cloud_proposal_s proposal;
5048:   uint32_t now_ms = lv_tick_get();
5049:   time_t now;
5050:   struct tm local;
5051:   int ret;
5052: 
5053:   if (!g_family_model_valid || g_network_state != NETWORK_ONLINE ||
5054:       mijia_state != HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_AUTHENTICATED)
5055:     {
5056:       return;
5057:     }
5058:   now = time(NULL);
5059:   if (now < TIME_VALID_EPOCH)
5060:     {
5061:       return;
5062:     }
5063:   home_panel_mijia_get_board_proposal(&proposal);
5064:   if (g_last_cloud_state_upload == 0 ||
5065:       lv_tick_elaps(g_last_cloud_state_upload) >= CLOUD_STATE_UPLOAD_MS)
5066:     {
5067:       time_t local_epoch = now + 8 * 60 * 60;
5068: 
5069:       gmtime_r(&local_epoch, &local);
5070:       g_cloud_state_revision++;
5071:       if (g_cloud_state_revision == 0)
5072:         {
5073:           g_cloud_state_revision = 1;
5074:         }
5075:       ret = home_panel_mijia_request_board_state(
5076:         &g_family_model, g_cloud_state_revision,
5077:         proposal.valid ? proposal.revision : 0,
5078:         (uint64_t)now, local.tm_hour * 60u + local.tm_min);
5079:       if (ret == 0)
5080:         {
5081:           g_last_cloud_state_upload = now_ms;
5082:         }
5083:       return;
5084:     }
5085:   if (g_last_cloud_proposal_poll == 0 ||
5086:       lv_tick_elaps(g_last_cloud_proposal_poll) >= CLOUD_PROPOSAL_POLL_MS)
5087:     {
5088:       ret = home_panel_mijia_request_board_proposal(
5089:         proposal.valid ? proposal.revision : 0);
5090:       if (ret == 0)
5091:         {
5092:           g_last_cloud_proposal_poll = now_ms;
5093:         }
5094:     }
5095: }

5619: static bool device_structure_changed(
5620:   const struct home_panel_device_s *before,
5621:   const struct home_panel_device_s *after)
5622: {
5623:   unsigned int index;
5624: 
5625:   if (strcmp(before->did, after->did) != 0 ||
5626:       strcmp(before->name, after->name) != 0 ||
5627:       strcmp(before->room, after->room) != 0 ||
5628:       strcmp(before->model, after->model) != 0 ||
5629:       strcmp(before->type, after->type) != 0 ||
5630:       before->has_power != after->has_power ||
5631:       before->power_writable != after->power_writable ||
5632:       before->power_siid != after->power_siid ||
5633:       before->power_piid != after->power_piid ||
5634:       before->has_brightness != after->has_brightness ||
5635:       before->has_temperature != after->has_temperature ||
5636:       before->has_humidity != after->has_humidity ||
5637:       before->has_battery != after->has_battery ||
5638:       before->control_count != after->control_count)
5639:     {
5640:       return true;
5641:     }
5642: 
5643:   for (index = 0; index < after->control_count; index++)
5644:     {
5645:       const struct home_panel_control_s *left = &before->controls[index];
5646:       const struct home_panel_control_s *right = &after->controls[index];
5647: 
5648:       if (strcmp(left->name, right->name) != 0 ||
5649:           left->siid != right->siid || left->piid != right->piid ||
5650:           left->type != right->type ||
5651:           left->has_range != right->has_range ||
5652:           left->minimum != right->minimum ||
5653:           left->maximum != right->maximum || left->step != right->step)
5654:         {
5655:           return true;
5656:         }
5657:     }
5658: 
5659:   return false;
5660: }

5707: static void update_device_binding(
5708:   struct home_panel_device_binding_s *binding)
5709: {
5710:   const struct home_panel_device_s *device = binding->device;
5711:   bool checked;
5712:   bool current_checked;
5713:   bool disabled;
5714:   bool state_text_changed;
5715:   char value[32];
5716: 
5717:   if (device == NULL || binding->value_label == NULL ||
5718:       binding->state_label == NULL)
5719:     {
5720:       return;
5721:     }
5722: 
5723:   checked = device->has_power && device->power;
5724:   format_device_value(device, value, sizeof(value));
5725:   set_label_text_if_changed(binding->value_label, value);
5726:   state_text_changed = set_label_text_if_changed(
5727:     binding->state_label, device_state_text(device));
5728: 
5729:   if (binding->card != NULL)
5730:     {
5731:       theme_apply_card_state(
5732:         binding->card,
5733:         !device->online ? HOME_PANEL_CARD_OFFLINE :
5734:         checked ? HOME_PANEL_CARD_ACTIVE : HOME_PANEL_CARD_IDLE);
5735:     }
5736: 
5737:   if (binding->button == NULL)
5738:     {
5739:       if (state_text_changed)
5740:         {
5741:           lv_obj_set_style_text_color(
5742:             binding->state_label,
5743:             lv_color_hex(device->online ? COLOR_SECONDARY : COLOR_MUTED),
5744:             0);
5745:         }
5746:       return;
5747:     }
5748: 
5749:   current_checked = lv_obj_has_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
5750:   if (state_text_changed || checked != current_checked)
5751:     {
5752:       lv_obj_set_style_text_color(
5753:         binding->state_label,
5754:         lv_color_hex(checked ? COLOR_GREEN : COLOR_MUTED), 0);
5755:     }
5756: 
5757:   if (checked != current_checked)
5758:     {
5759:       style_toggle(binding->button, checked);
5760:       if (checked)
5761:         {
5762:           lv_obj_add_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
5763:         }
5764:       else
5765:         {
5766:           lv_obj_remove_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
5767:         }
5768:     }
5769: 
5770:   disabled = lv_obj_has_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
5771:   if (device->online && disabled)
5772:     {
5773:       lv_obj_remove_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
5774:     }
5775:   else if (!device->online && !disabled)
5776:     {
5777:       lv_obj_add_state(binding->button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
5778:     }
5779: }

6407:           return -ENODEV;
6408:         }
6409:       control = proactive_find_control(device, action->siid, action->piid);
6410:       if (control == NULL || !proactive_safe_action_control(control) ||
6411:           !control->has_value ||
6412:           (action->value_is_boolean ?
6413:             control->type != HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN :
6414:             !cloud_number_allowed(control, action->value)))
6415:         {
6416:           return -EPERM;
6417:         }
6418:       current = control->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN ?
6419:                   (control->boolean_value ? 1 : 0) : control->value;
6420:       if (current == action->value)
6421:         {
6422:           g_cloud_execution.action_index++;
6423:           continue;
6424:         }
6425:       ret = action->value_is_boolean ?
6426:         home_panel_mijia_request_bool_property(
6427:           device->did, device->name, control->name,
6428:           control->siid, control->piid, action->value != 0) :
6429:         home_panel_mijia_request_number_property(
6430:           device->did, device->name, control->name,
6431:           control->siid, control->piid, action->value);
6432:       if (ret != 0)
6433:         {
6434:           return ret;
6435:         }
6436:       memset(&g_proactive_command, 0, sizeof(g_proactive_command));
6437:       g_proactive_command.device_hash = action->device_hash;
6438:       g_proactive_command.deadline_ms = lv_tick_get() + 15000u;
6439:       g_proactive_command.siid = action->siid;
6440:       g_proactive_command.piid = action->piid;
6441:       g_proactive_command.value = action->value;
6442:       g_proactive_command.kind = action->value_is_boolean ?
6443:         HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_BOOLEAN : HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_NUMBER;
6444:       g_proactive_command.active = true;
6445:       g_proactive_command.cloud_execution = true;
6446:       return 0;
6447:     }
6448:   if (g_cloud_execution.active)
6449:     {
6450:       cloud_finish_execution(true);
6451:     }
6452:   return 1;
6453: }

6492:     {
6493:       return;

6495:   if (proposal.update_revision == g_cloud_plan_handled_revision)
6496:     {
6497:       return;
6498:     }
6499:   if (!cloud_build_record(&proposal, &record, true))
6500:     {
6501:       g_cloud_plan_handled_revision = proposal.update_revision;
6502:       cloud_queue_feedback(proposal.proposal_id, "execution_failed");
6503:       set_label_text_if_changed(
6504:         g_proactive_feedback_label,
6505:         "服务端计划未通过板端能力与安全校验，未保存");
6506:       return;
6507:     }
6508:   for (index = 0; index < g_cloud_automation_count; index++)
6509:     {
6510:       if (g_cloud_automations[index].routine_id == record.routine_id)
6511:         {
6512:           if (memcmp(&g_cloud_automations[index], &record,
6513:                      sizeof(record)) != 0)
6514:             {
6515:               g_cloud_automations[index] = record;
6516:               changed = true;
6517:             }
6518:           break;
6519:         }
6520:     }
6521:   if (index == g_cloud_automation_count)
6522:     {
6523:       if (g_cloud_automation_count >= CLOUD_AUTOMATION_MAX)
6524:         {
6525:           g_cloud_plan_handled_revision = proposal.update_revision;
6526:           cloud_queue_feedback(proposal.proposal_id, "execution_failed");
6527:           set_label_text_if_changed(g_proactive_feedback_label,
6528:                                     "离线自动化已满，请先删除旧规则");
6529:           return;
6530:         }
6531:       g_cloud_automations[g_cloud_automation_count++] = record;
6532:       changed = true;
6533:     }
6534:   if (changed)
6535:     {
6536:       schedule_proactive_persist();
6537:       g_proactive_automation_signature = 0;
6538:     }
6539:   g_cloud_plan_handled_revision = proposal.update_revision;
6540:   cloud_queue_feedback(proposal.proposal_id, "automation_saved");
6541:   set_label_text_if_changed(g_proactive_feedback_label,
6542:                             "多设备自动化已保存，可在断网时运行");

6545: static void process_cloud_automations(void)
6546: {
6547:   uint32_t day;
6548:   uint16_t minute;
6549:   unsigned int index;
6550: 
6551:   if (g_cloud_feedback_count > 0)
6552:     {
6553:       const struct cloud_feedback_s *feedback = &g_cloud_feedback_queue[0];
6554:       int ret = home_panel_mijia_feedback_board_proposal(
6555:         feedback->proposal_id, feedback->result);
6556:       if (ret == 0)
6557:         {
6558:           g_cloud_feedback_count--;
6559:           if (g_cloud_feedback_count > 0)
6560:             {
6561:               memmove(&g_cloud_feedback_queue[0],
6562:                       &g_cloud_feedback_queue[1],
6563:                       sizeof(g_cloud_feedback_queue[0]) *
6564:                         g_cloud_feedback_count);
6565:             }
6566:           memset(&g_cloud_feedback_queue[g_cloud_feedback_count], 0,
6567:                  sizeof(g_cloud_feedback_queue[0]));
6568:         }
6569:     }
6570:   process_cloud_proposal();
6571:   if (g_cloud_execution.active)
6572:     {
6573:       if (!g_proactive_command.active)
6574:         {
6575:           int ret = cloud_send_next_action();
6576:           if (ret < 0 && ret != -EBUSY)
6577:             {
6578:               cloud_finish_execution(false);
6579:             }
6580:         }
6581:       return;
6582:     }
6583:   if (g_proactive_command.active || !proactive_event_time(&day, &minute))
6584:     {
6585:       return;
6586:     }
6587:   for (index = 0; index < g_cloud_automation_count; index++)
6588:     {
6589:       struct cloud_automation_record_s *record =
6590:         &g_cloud_automations[index];
6591:       bool due = false;
6592: 
6593:       if (record->last_executed_day == day)
6594:         {
6595:           continue;
6596:         }
6597:       if (record->trigger_kind == HOME_PANEL_CLOUD_TRIGGER_TIME)
6598:         {
6599:           time_t now = time(NULL) + 8 * 60 * 60;
6600:           struct tm current;
6601:           unsigned int weekday;
6602: 
6603:           gmtime_r(&now, &current);
6604:           weekday = (current.tm_wday + 6) % 7;
6605:           due = (record->days_mask & (1u << weekday)) != 0 &&
6606:                 ((record->minute_of_day + record->window_minutes < 1440 &&
6607:                   minute >= record->minute_of_day &&
6608:                   minute <= record->minute_of_day +
6609:                             record->window_minutes) ||
6610:                  (record->minute_of_day + record->window_minutes >= 1440 &&
6611:                   (minute >= record->minute_of_day ||
6612:                    minute <= record->minute_of_day +
6613:                              record->window_minutes - 1440)));
6614:         }
6615:       else if (record->trigger_kind == HOME_PANEL_CLOUD_TRIGGER_PROPERTY &&
6616:                g_cloud_due_at[index] != 0 &&
6617:                (int32_t)(lv_tick_get() - g_cloud_due_at[index]) >= 0)
6618:         {
6619:           due = true;
6620:           g_cloud_due_at[index] = 0;
6621:         }
6622:       if (due && cloud_start_execution(record, false, NULL))
6623:         {
6624:           syslog(LOG_INFO,
6625:                  "[HOME][AGENT] offline cloud automation=%u actions=%u\n",
6626:                  (unsigned int)record->routine_id,
6627:                  (unsigned int)record->action_count);
6628:           break;
6629:         }
6630:     }
6631: }

6633: static bool proactive_event_time(uint32_t *day_ordinal,
6634:                                   uint16_t *minute_of_day)
6635: {
6636:   struct tm local_time;
6637:   time_t now = time(NULL);
6638: 
6639:   if (now < TIME_VALID_EPOCH)
6640:     {
6641:       return false;
6642:     }
6643: 
6644:   now += 8 * 60 * 60;
6645:   *day_ordinal = (uint32_t)(now / (24 * 60 * 60));
6646:   gmtime_r(&now, &local_time);
6647:   *minute_of_day =
6648:     (uint16_t)(local_time.tm_hour * 60 + local_time.tm_min);
6649:   return true;
6650: }

6652: static bool proactive_command_matches(
6653:   const struct home_proactive_event_s *event)
6654: {

6657:       event->device_hash != g_proactive_command.device_hash ||
6658:       event->siid != g_proactive_command.siid ||
6659:       event->piid != g_proactive_command.piid ||
6660:       event->kind != g_proactive_command.kind ||
6661:       event->value != g_proactive_command.value)
6662:     {
6663:       return false;
6664:     }
6665: 
6666:   return true;
6667: }

6669: static void proactive_observe_model_event(
6670:   struct home_proactive_event_s *event)
6671: {
6672:   struct home_proactive_snapshot_s before;
6673:   struct home_proactive_snapshot_s after;
6674:   bool command_match;
6675: 
6676:   home_proactive_get_snapshot(&before);
6677:   command_match = proactive_command_matches(event);
6678:   event->self_generated = command_match;
6679:   home_proactive_observe_event(event);
6680:   if (!command_match)
6681:     {
6682:       unsigned int index;
6683: 
6684:       for (index = 0; index < g_cloud_automation_count; index++)
6685:         {
6686:           const struct cloud_automation_record_s *record =
6687:             &g_cloud_automations[index];
6688: 
6689:           if (record->trigger_kind ==
6690:                 HOME_PANEL_CLOUD_TRIGGER_PROPERTY &&
6691:               record->trigger_device_hash == event->device_hash &&
6692:               record->trigger_siid == event->siid &&
6693:               record->trigger_piid == event->piid &&
6694:               record->trigger_value == event->value &&
6695:               ((record->trigger_value_is_boolean &&
6696:                 event->kind == HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_BOOLEAN) ||
6697:                (!record->trigger_value_is_boolean &&
6698:                 event->kind == HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_NUMBER)))
6699:             {
6700:               g_cloud_due_at[index] =
6701:                 event->now_ms + record->delay_seconds * 1000u;
6702:             }
6703:         }
6704:     }
6705:   if (command_match)
6706:     {
6707:       if (g_proactive_command.cloud_execution)
6708:         {
6709:           g_cloud_execution.action_index++;
6710:         }
6711:       else if (g_proactive_command.automation)
6712:         {
6713:           home_proactive_automation_result(true);
6714:         }
6715:       if (g_proactive_command.feedback_pending)
6716:         {
6717:           home_proactive_feedback(
6718:             g_proactive_command.feedback_on_success);
6719:           schedule_proactive_persist();
6720:           syslog(LOG_INFO,
6721:                  "[HOME][AGENT] confirmed feedback=%u key=%u\n",
6722:                  (unsigned int)g_proactive_command.feedback_on_success,
6723:                  (unsigned int)g_proactive_command.decision_key);
6724:         }
6725:       memset(&g_proactive_command, 0, sizeof(g_proactive_command));
6726:     }
6727:   home_proactive_get_snapshot(&after);
6728: 
6729:   if (after.mode == HOME_PROACTIVE_REAL &&
6730:       (after.routine_count != before.routine_count ||
6731:        after.routine_observations != before.routine_observations ||
6732:        after.automation_count != before.automation_count))
6733:     {
6734:       schedule_proactive_persist();
6735:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
6736:              "[HOME][AGENT] learned routines=%u observations=%u "
6737:              "automations=%u\n",
6738:              after.routine_count, after.routine_observations,
6739:              after.automation_count);
6740:     }
6741: }

6743: static void proactive_observe_model_changes(
6744:   const struct home_panel_family_model_s *previous,
6745:   const struct home_panel_family_model_s *next)
6746: {
6747:   struct home_proactive_event_s event;
6748:   uint32_t day_ordinal;
6749:   uint16_t minute_of_day;
6750:   uint32_t now_ms;
6751:   unsigned int device_index;
6752: 
6753:   if (!proactive_event_time(&day_ordinal, &minute_of_day))
6754:     {
6755:       return;
6756:     }
6757: 
6758:   now_ms = lv_tick_get();
6759:   for (device_index = 0; device_index < next->device_count; device_index++)
6760:     {
6761:       const struct home_panel_device_s *device =
6762:         &next->devices[device_index];
6763:       const struct home_panel_device_s *old_device =
6764:         proactive_find_device(previous, device->did);
6765:       unsigned int observable_index;
6766: 
6767:       if (old_device == NULL)
6768:         {
6769:           continue;
6770:         }
6771: 
6772:       if (old_device->online != device->online)
6773:         {
6774:           memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
6775:           event.device_hash = proactive_hash_device_id(device->did);
6776:           event.day_ordinal = day_ordinal;
6777:           event.now_ms = now_ms;
6778:           event.minute_of_day = minute_of_day;
6779:           event.value = device->online ? 1 : 0;
6780:           event.kind = HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_ONLINE;
6781:           proactive_observe_model_event(&event);
6782:         }
6783: 
6784:       for (observable_index = 0;
6785:            observable_index < device->observable_count;
6786:            observable_index++)
6787:         {
6788:           const struct home_panel_observable_s *observable =
6789:             &device->observables[observable_index];
6790:           const struct home_panel_observable_s *old_observable =
6791:             proactive_find_observable(old_device, observable->siid,
6792:                                       observable->piid);
6793:           const struct home_panel_control_s *control;
6794:           bool changed;
6795: 
6796:           if (old_observable == NULL || !observable->has_value ||
6797:               !old_observable->has_value ||
6798:               old_observable->type != observable->type)
6799:             {
6800:               continue;
6801:             }
6802: 
6803:           changed = observable->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN ?
6804:                     old_observable->boolean_value !=
6805:                       observable->boolean_value :
6806:                     old_observable->value != observable->value;
6807:           if (!changed)
6808:             {
6809:               continue;
6810:             }
6811: 
6812:           control = proactive_find_control(device, observable->siid,
6813:                                            observable->piid);
6814:           memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
6815:           event.device_hash = proactive_hash_device_id(device->did);
6816:           event.day_ordinal = day_ordinal;
6817:           event.now_ms = now_ms;
6818:           event.minute_of_day = minute_of_day;
6819:           event.siid = observable->siid;
6820:           event.piid = observable->piid;
6821:           event.value =
6822:             observable->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN ?
6823:               (observable->boolean_value ? 1 : 0) : observable->value;
6824:           event.kind =
6825:             observable->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN ?
6826:               HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_BOOLEAN :
6827:               HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_NUMBER;
6828:           event.writable =
6829:             control != NULL && proactive_safe_action_device(device);
6830:           proactive_observe_model_event(&event);
6831:         }
6832:     }
6833: }

+/****************************************************************************
+ * D13x home panel - Public UI page API
+ *
+ * This header is the ONLY interface main.c uses to interact with UI pages.
+ * Pages receive model/state through parameters, never access network
+ * threads, Mijia request internals, or proactive engine state directly.
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+#ifndef __HOME_UI_H
+#define __HOME_UI_H
+
+#include <lvgl/lvgl.h>
+#include "home_panel_mijia_model.h"
+#include "home_panel_proactive.h"
+#include "home_panel_mijia_client.h"
+
+/* Page indices */
+
+#define HOME_PAGE_COUNT   5
+#define HOME_CARD_COUNT   3
+#define PROACTIVE_PAGE    3
+
+/* Layout constants */
+
+#define ROOM_NAV_WIDTH    170
+#define ROOM_CARD_WIDTH   260
+#define ROOM_CARD_HEIGHT  108
+
+/* Network state - shared between main.c and UI pages */
+
+enum home_ui_network_state_e
+{
+  HOME_UI_NET_INITIALIZING = 0,
+  HOME_UI_NET_DISCONNECTED,
+  HOME_UI_NET_CHECKING,
+  HOME_UI_NET_NO_INTERNET,
+  HOME_UI_NET_ONLINE
+};
+
+/* Page result returned by page create functions.
+ * Contains the page container and per-page status label.
+ */
+
+struct home_ui_page_s
+{
+  lv_obj_t *container;
+  lv_obj_t *status_label;
+};
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Page lifecycle - main.c calls these
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/* Create the entire home screen (topbar + nav + page host).
+ * Must be called once at startup after LVGL init.
+ */
+
+void home_ui_create_screen(void);
+
+/* Navigation */
+
+void home_ui_show_page(unsigned int page);
+void home_ui_delete_page(unsigned int page);
+
+/* Global UI updates - main.c calls these when state changes */
+
+void home_ui_update_network(enum home_ui_network_state_e state);
+void home_ui_update_time(bool force);
+void home_ui_apply_mijia_snapshot(
+  const struct home_panel_mijia_snapshot_s *snapshot);
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Page-specific update APIs
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/* Home page */
+
+void home_ui_home_update_suggestion(void);
+
+/* Proactive page */
+
+void home_ui_proactive_update_widgets(void);
+void home_ui_proactive_update_context(void);
+void home_ui_proactive_update_home_suggestion(void);
+
+/* Settings page */
+
+void home_ui_settings_update_network(enum home_ui_network_state_e state);
+
+/* Rooms page */
+
+void home_ui_rooms_update_button_styles(void);
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Accessors for shared state that pages need
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+const struct home_panel_family_model_s *home_ui_get_family_model(void);
+bool home_ui_is_family_model_valid(void);
+unsigned int home_ui_get_current_page(void);
+unsigned int home_ui_get_selected_room(void);
+enum home_ui_network_state_e home_ui_get_network_state(void);
+
+/* Status label management */
+
+lv_obj_t *home_ui_get_status_label(void);
+void home_ui_set_status_label(lv_obj_t *label);
+
+/* Login */
+
+void home_ui_show_login(lv_event_t *event);
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Page-specific callbacks that main.c needs to register
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/* Proactive feedback callback - main.c provides the implementation */
+
+typedef void (*home_ui_proactive_feedback_cb_t)(
+  enum home_proactive_feedback_e feedback, bool confirmed);
+
+void home_ui_set_proactive_feedback_callback(
+  home_ui_proactive_feedback_cb_t cb);
+
+/* Cloud state callbacks - main.c provides these */
+
+void home_ui_proactive_handle_feedback(enum home_proactive_feedback_e feedback,
+                                       bool confirmed);
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Model refresh
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/* Call when family model structure changes - rebuilds visible page */
+
+void home_ui_on_model_structure_changed(void);
+
+/* Call when model data changes (not structure) - updates bindings in place */
+
+void home_ui_on_model_data_changed(void);
+
+#endif
